query:
SELECT e.id, e.description, e.supplierId, p.id as partnerId, p.tradeName
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN partners p ON e.supplierId = p.id
WHERE e.status != 'CANCELADA' AND p.id IS NULL
LIMIT 10
